# get_region_props_for_regions { #mofography.compute.get_region_props_for_regions }

`compute.get_region_props_for_regions(regions)`

It takes a list of regions and returns a list of region properties

## Parameters

| Name      | Type   | Description       | Default    |
|-----------|--------|-------------------|------------|
| `regions` |        | The labeled image | _required_ |
